record.question: What is the full form of NIELIT?
options: North Indian Electrical Line & Information Technology
National Institute for Electronics and Industrial Technology
National Institute for Electronics and Information Technology
National Institute for Electrical and Information Technology
record.explanation: Answer C: National Institute for Electronics and Information Technology. The intended expansion is National Institute of Electronics & Information Technology (NIELIT). Option (c) is the closest/intended match, but it prints “for Electronics” instead of the official “of Electronics”; keep that visible wording correction rather than asserting the printed text is the exact official name. Reference: https://www.nielit.gov.in/content/about-us. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
